title: Anth.us Amplify app link: create GitHub token secret and set repositoryAccessTokenSecretArn (Mac)
description: Papyrus PR 335 lets the app shell set the Amplify repository from site.json via repositoryAccessTokenSecretArn (Secrets Manager). Remaining, on the Mac: create the GitHub token secret in the papyrus-production account, add its ARN to the Anth.us site.json by PR, and let the stack pipeline deploy it, so Amplify app d7s858igkyct5 moves off anthusai/anth.us-papyrus. No manual deploy.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Superseded: no token-free API path exists and a token is not possible. The Anth.us repo link (Amplify d7s858igkyct5, anthusai/anth.us-papyrus) needs the one-time Amplify console GitHub App connect, see docs/site-hosting.md.
